rationale: The assistant correctly framed heat pump dryers as cooler and slower from the first reply, checked filters/programme, then correctly identified the cold garage, full load, 1000 rpm spin and door opening as the explanations, matching the hidden truth of normal operation. It never claimed a fault and kept engineer referral conditional on a sensible test. Minor weaknesses: an odd, unneeded 'switch it off and unplug it' line, the two-thirds-load test repeated across three replies, and no mention that a one-month-old Bosch would be covered by warranty rather than needing a paid engineer.
